title: Document recipe detail sheet architecture
description: Produce or update developer-facing documentation covering: the RecipeDetailSheet component hierarchy and data flow; how the single @State currentScale binding is shared between IngredientsView and RecipeBottomBar; the sibling-image loading convention and security-scoped bookmark lifecycle in RecipeImageLoader; RecipeStepCombiner's item-resolution algorithm; and the placeholder-alert pattern used for deferred Add-to-menu / Add-to-shopping-list actions. Note visual aspects (gradient legibility, spacing, animation) as 'implemented per spec, manual visual review needed by user'.
acceptance_criteria: Scale @State sharing pattern explained with binding flow diagram or prose.
Sibling-image loading documented, referencing security-scoped bookmark start/stop lifecycle.
Placeholder alert pattern documented with reference to 0007 and 0013 follow-up specs.
Visual aspects flagged as requiring manual review by the user.
